technical.summary: Bullish momentum signals (RSI, MACD, PPO crossovers, volume spike) conflict with overbought conditions and lack of longer-term trend alignment; moderate swing entry with elevated risk of pullback.

fundamental.summary: No actionable smart money signals detected; insider/institutional activity absent; earnings in 55 days presents material risk with no offsetting conviction indicators.

sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal for COST; congressional trades are small-amount, mixed-direction activity from junior members; broad market sentiment neutral with slight bearish bias (42% bearish vs 21% bullish) offers no contrarian edge.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (214.4) indicates extreme market stress, NFP event imminent (0 days), and earnings in 55 days create compounded uncertainty for Consumer Staples sector.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong short-term momentum (RSI bullish, MACD/PPO crossovers, 15x volume spike, supertrend bullish) with price near support (429.13) offers defined risk swing entry if macro headwinds ease.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators (StochRSI, Williams %R), price below 200-EMA and 50-SMA, inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels (214.4), imminent NFP event, and 55-day earnings risk create compounded macro/technical headwinds that outweigh momentum signals.
